When questioned regarding settling outside the lead rider stated that he was instructed to attempt to obtain a more prominent position. He said when ridden positively from the outside barrier the gelding displayed more early speed than he had anticipated to occupy the position outside the lead. Trainer confirmed that he had asked rider to be more positive on the horse anticipating it would settle near midfield. Tnr was reminded of the requirement to advise Stewards of any intended change of tactics.
